title: R31 executable oracle coverage map
scope: Maps every R31 record to concrete Python and JavaScript tests. Coverage mapping is not itself a certification: source-level derivation and renderer validation remain separate gates.

javascript_tests: stop-motion jitter deterministic and bounded
records.oracle_basis: deterministic hash bounds and fixed-seed fixtures

javascript_tests: FABRIK preserves lengths and reaches target
records.oracle_basis: segment-length invariants and reachability geometry

javascript_tests: dual quaternion normalization matches Python reference
dual-quaternion blending corrects antipodal signs before normalization
records.oracle_basis: unit quaternion and Study-condition invariants; antipodal blend invariance

javascript_tests: temporal quantization matches Python references
records.oracle_basis: floor quantization boundary cases

javascript_tests: XPBD rigid projection matches Python reference
XPBD compliance scaling changes with dt exactly as alpha/dt^2
records.oracle_basis: closed-form scalar constraint projection and alpha/dt^2 dimensional relation

javascript_tests: spatial hash uses floor for negative coordinates
Teschner spatial hash maps integer cells into a bounded table bucket
records.oracle_basis: negative-coordinate floor oracle and published integer hash constants

javascript_tests: hair GGX NDF and tilted half-vector match Huang et al. Appendix A
records.oracle_basis: published Huang et al. Appendix A equations and limiting values

javascript_tests: structure tensor orientation matches reference
structure tensor separates gradient normal from brush tangent
structure tensor rejects non-positive-semidefinite matrices
records.oracle_basis: closed-form eigenvalues, eigenvectors, coherence and PSD determinant condition

javascript_tests: anisotropic Kuwahara matches published weight equation and Python oracle
weighted sector mean matches reference convention
records.oracle_basis: published sector weight equation and normalized weighted mean

javascript_tests: impasto segment distance has analytic projection and endpoint cases
impasto compact profile has exact center and zero outside support
impasto central gradient and normal satisfy plane oracle
records.oracle_basis: analytic point-segment projection, compact profile support, exact plane gradient and unit-normal invariant

javascript_tests: flow-oriented detail repeats over its along-flow wavelength
erosion amplitude is bounded and zero slope leaves base unchanged
records.oracle_basis: periodicity, zero-slope limit and amplitude bound; explicitly authored anisotropic Fourier prototype, not Phasor-paper reproduction

javascript_tests: smooth minimum matches Python reference
records.oracle_basis: closed-form smooth-min limiting cases

javascript_tests: camera transported normal remains unit and orthogonal
double-reflection camera frame is orthonormal
double-reflection camera frame preserves straight-line orientation
records.oracle_basis: orthonormal frame and straight-line transport invariants

javascript_tests: depth-normal contour score uses normalized dimensionless cues
depth-normal contour coverage has analytic smoothstep boundaries
records.oracle_basis: closed-form depth jump, normalized normal dot and smoothstep boundary conditions

javascript_tests: halftone threshold coverage has binary and antialiased limits
sinusoidal halftone mask has period 2/f and remains in [0,1]
records.oracle_basis: analytic spatial period and binary/antialias limiting behavior

javascript_tests: vector-field hatching repeats and antialiases around the stripe

javascript_tests: boids steering vectors match reference directions

voxel face material/normal/AO key splits rectangles
